title: ParameterIDs.h v1 inventory (voiceCount, spreads, humanRate, tightness, pans, masterSeed non-param), APVTS with skews, bus layout, PluginProcessor spine with V=4 worst-case allocation and PDC hooks
description:
Sole PluginProcessor owner for phase a. Define stable parameter IDs and the processor spine (APVTS, buses, prepare allocations stubs, PDC hooks). Do not implement the full ShredDoubleEngine DSP yet.

Before editing, inspect:
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/Source/ParameterIDs.h
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp (APVTS layout, bus checks, get/setStateInformation hooks, setLatencySamples)
- Source/DSP/* headers copied in a.2 (include paths only)
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §§4.9–4.10, 5, 8, 11

Implement:
1. Source/ParameterIDs.h under namespace ShredDouble::ParameterIDs:
   - parameterLayoutVersion = 1 (and schemaVersion alias if matching shred-width style)
   - string IDs never-renumber: voiceCount, timingSpread, pitchSpread, humanRate, tightness, monoXover, mix, panV1, panV2, panV3, panV4, width, latencyMode, outTrim, bypass
   - non-parameter property name constant for masterSeed (e.g. masterSeed) documented as value-tree only, not APVTS param
2. PluginProcessor.h/.cpp class ShredDoubleAudioProcessor:
   - APVTS created via createParameterLayout() with ranges/defaults from spec §5: voiceCount choice {2,4} default 2; timingSpread 0–15 default 6.0; pitchSpread 0–10 default 5.0; humanRate 0–100 default 50; tightness 0–100 default 50; monoXover 80–300 default 180 with NormalisableRange log/skew ≈ 0.35; mix 0–100 default 50; panV1..V4 defaults -100,+100,-60,+60; width 0–200 default 100; latencyMode {Studio,Live} default Studio; outTrim -12..+12 default 0; bypass bool default false
   - isBusesLayoutSupported: mono→stereo and stereo→stereo only
   - processBlock stub: ScopedNoDenormals, clear spare channels, no DSP yet (passthrough or silence-safe stub)
   - prepareToPlay: record sampleRate/blockSize; allocate for V=4 worst case sizing comments/members ready for later engine (4× pitch buffers L=2048+4 intent, 4× delay ceil(35ms*maxSR)+guard, 4× allpass chain slots, 1× crossover, 1× dry-align 1024, metering FIFO capacity placeholder, 8× PRNG POD states). Prefer lightweight member placeholders/reserves rather than inventing full Engine class here if Engine is phase later—still call setLatencySamples via updateReportedLatencyFromParameter stub matching Studio/Live PDC hooks from §4.9
   - createEditor forward-declared; hasEditor true
   - standard AudioProcessor program/name/MIDI boilerplate
   - getStateInformation/setStateInformation may defer body details to StateManager (a.4) but must compile: either minimal APVTS XML round-trip plus masterSeed property placeholder, or call StateManager if header can be included with a thin stub

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/ParameterIDs.h exists with ShredDouble::ParameterIDs string IDs for voiceCount timingSpread pitchSpread humanRate tightness monoXover mix panV1 panV2 panV3 panV4 width latencyMode outTrim bypass and parameterLayoutVersion == 1
Source/ParameterIDs.h documents or defines masterSeed as non-host-automatable state property name
Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp define ShredDoubleAudioProcessor with juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState apvts

createParameterLayout encodes defaults voiceCount=2 timingSpread=6.0 pitchSpread=5.0 humanRate=50 tightness=50 monoXover=180 mix=50 panV1=-100 panV2=100 panV3=-60 panV4=60 width=100 latencyMode=Studio outTrim=0 bypass=false
isBusesLayoutSupported accepts mono-to-stereo and stereo-to-stereo only
prepareToPlay establishes V=4 worst-case allocation hooks or reserves and setLatencySamples PDC path for latencyMode
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify the eight reused DSP/GUI files copied in a.2
modify Source/PluginEditor.* or Source/StateManager.* (owned by a.4)
implement full RandomWalk/AllpassChain/ShredDoubleEngine DSP in this task
make masterSeed a host-automatable APVTS parameter

allowed: thin processor spine with placeholder members for later engine wiring
minimal get/setStateInformation that preserves APVTS XML and masterSeed property version
mirror shred-width processor lifecycle patterns renamed to ShredDouble
forbidden: change bus policy beyond mono->stereo and stereo->stereo
renumber or rename v1 parameter string IDs after writing them
